title: OpenRouter inference-provider prompt handling and ZDR eligibility failures
summary: Following Dragos canary-token findings, OpenRouter said on November 22 it off-boarded three inference providers, removed 125 endpoints from Zero Data Retention eligibility and notified potentially affected customers. Some provider investigations remain open; no breach of OpenRouter itself was reported.

rootCause.summary: Provider compromise, unapproved data retention and marketplace routing/logging practices identified by researchers; causes vary across providers.

history.summary: OpenRouter disclosed removal of three providers and ZDR eligibility for 125 endpoints following independent evidence of prompt leaks and data-policy failures. Investigations and provider assurances remain ongoing.
